Senses.Explanation: A considerable duration: “a good while.” In dialogue and teaching-hall addresses it is often rendered “after a long pause.” Shoushan Xingnian pauses and then asks whether the questioner understands; Yunfeng Wenyue pauses, shouts, and steps down; Yinyuan Longqi raises the fly-whisk after the interval; and Yulin Tongxiu plants the staff. The word does not itself encode an authoritative silence: in Songshan Junji's recorded exchange, the record's unnamed monk is the one who pauses. Huanglong Huinan asks whether anyone has a question, waits while no one asks, and leaves. Chan records also deploy the Buddha pausing after a non-Buddhist asks about neither the spoken nor the unspoken, and Mahakasyapa ascending the seat before King Ajatashatru, waiting a good while, and descending without preaching. In Dayang Jingxuan's exchange the headword instead marks ordinary elapsed time before Dayang summons Touzi Yiqing and speaks. These intervals denote the same duration; the entry does not assign the silence an unstated meaning.
Senses.Note: The apparatus-clean allowlist count is 11,566 hits across 387 texts. One corpus-wide temporal sense remains warranted: held silence is a recurrent Chan deployment, not part of the denotation in every occurrence. The witnesses preserve the Buddha and Mahakasyapa cases, named speakers' pauses and following actions, one genuinely unnamed monk's pause, an assembly's unanswered wait, and ordinary elapsed narrative time. Complete-case review resolves every actor except that unnamed monk; all six attribution-ladder rungs fail to name him, so that one row remains explicitly weak rather than being assigned to respondent Songshan Junji.

Occurrences.Kwic: 世尊良久。外道讚歎曰：「世尊大慈，開我迷雲，令我得入。」乃作禮而去。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: In the Recorded Sayings of Shouchang Wuming (壽昌無明和尚語錄), Shouchang Wuming raises an old case in which The Buddha pauses after a non-Buddhist asks about neither the spoken nor the unspoken; the questioner then praises The Buddha. The exact actor of the interval is The Buddha, not Shouchang.

Occurrences.Kwic: 外道問佛云不問有言不問無言世尊良久外道禮拜云善哉世尊大慈大悲開我迷雲令我得入
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Collected Highlights of the Lamp, surviving fascicle (傳燈玉英集（殘卷）), independently records The Buddha pausing after the non-Buddhist's request; the questioner then bows and praises him. The exact actor of the interval is The Buddha.

Occurrences.Kwic: 問如何是佛師良久云會麼僧云不會師云何不高聲問
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Old Recorded Sayings of Venerable Masters (古尊宿語錄), in the explicit Shoushan Xingnian section (首山禪師): after being asked what buddha is, Shoushan pauses and asks, ‘Do you get it?’

Occurrences.Kwic: 僧問不涉思量處從上宗乘請師直道師良久僧曰恁麼即聽響之流徒勞側耳
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Collected Highlights of the Lamp, surviving fascicle (傳燈玉英集（殘卷）), in the explicit Zongxian Minghui section: when asked to state the lineage matter directly, Zongxian pauses and the unnamed monk responds. Zongxian Minghui is not yet on the roster.

Occurrences.Kwic: 寶在什麼處良久喝一喝下座
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Old Recorded Sayings of Venerable Masters (古尊宿語錄), in Yunfeng Wenyue's explicit record (雲峯禪師語): Yunfeng pauses, gives one shout, and steps down. Yunfeng Wenyue is not yet on the roster.

Occurrences.Kwic: 僧良久。師曰。會麼僧。曰。不會
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Five Lamps Meeting the Source (五燈會元), in Songshan Junji's explicit section (嵩山峻極禪師): the record does not name the speaker and actor of the pause—the unnamed monk, not Songshan Junji—before Songshan asks whether he understands. The line, ±500/±2,000/±10,000 context, section, title, TEI header, and parallel-case search do not name him; `MasterName` therefore remains null.

Occurrences.Kwic: 良久豎拂子云：「會麼？相知不用多杯酒，一盞清茶也醉人。」
Occurrences.AttributionNote: In his Recorded Sayings (隱元禪師語錄), Yinyuan Longqi pauses, raises the fly-whisk, asks whether the assembly understands, and continues with a line.

Occurrences.Kwic: 良久卓拄杖云拄杖子𨁝跳出來道和尚棒教誰喫
Occurrences.AttributionNote: In his Recorded Sayings (普濟玉琳國師語錄), Yulin Tongxiu pauses, plants the staff, and voices the staff's question about who is to receive the beating.

Occurrences.Kwic: 阿闍世王請師說法，師受請升座，良久乃下。王問師：「何故不為弟子說？」
Occurrences.AttributionNote: The Patriarchs' Hall Collection (祖堂集) raises a case in which Mahakasyapa, at King Ajatashatru's request, ascends the seat, remains for a good while, and descends without preaching. Mahakasyapa is the exact actor and is not yet on the roster.

Occurrences.Kwic: 陽曰得。良久乃召師。師應諾。陽曰。與爾箇入路。師於言下有省

ActorAttribution.GrammarEvidence: 良久乃召師 uses 良久 as a narrator-governed elapsed-time bridge before Dayang Jingxuan calls Touzi Yiqing; neither man performs the duration as a speech turn.

Occurrences.AttributionNote: The Continued Record of the Transmission of the Lamp (續傳燈錄), in Touzi Yiqing's biography: after ordinary elapsed time, Dayang Jingxuan calls Touzi, who answers and has insight at Dayang's following words. Dayang governs the summons across the interval.

Occurrences.Kwic: 莫有問話者麼。良久無人問。師乃去。

ActorAttribution.GrammarEvidence: 良久無人問 explicitly predicates that after a good while nobody in the assembly asked; Huanglong Huinan speaks before and leaves after the narrated interval but is not its personal actor.

Occurrences.AttributionNote: In his Recorded Sayings (黃龍慧南禪師語錄), Huanglong Huinan asks whether anyone has a question; after a good while with no question, Huanglong leaves. The interval records the assembly's public nonresponse inside his address.
